caption: The drawing depicts a brass andiron with a tall, pointed finial on top, a bulbous midsection, and a cylindrical lower shaft, supported by three curved legs that end in small round feet. The main object is shaded in tones of gold and yellow to suggest a metallic surface, with darker and lighter areas to indicate three-dimensional volume and light direction. Attached to the base is a horizontal bar extending backward, shaded in gray and black to resemble iron and to illustrate shadow. To the left of the main object, a detailed line drawing shows the same andiron in a simplified outline, including a scale labeled "inches" for reference. Both images are set against a light beige background and enclosed within a single, thin rectangular border. The bottom right corner of the drawing is labeled with the name "HANS KORSCH."
title: Andiron (one of pair)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
